correctness.rationale: The equivariant exact sequence is reconstructed from the simplex-skeleton relative homology and published shellability. For odd n/even k the stabilizing reflection has a unique fixed vertex in the omitted q-face. The invariant mod-two cycle boundary at the facet with that vertex removed equals 1 if any section lifts the missing facet, contradiction. Complete GF2 linear systems for 28 small cases independently support, but do not replace, this infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Both original full texts were inspected. The 2024 sequel already proves the full rational dihedral representation, so that is excluded. Neither paper supplies this mod-two nonsplitting obstruction to the canonical integral extension. Actual published-finding corpus searches and 91 accessible ledger claims reveal no implication-equivalent claim.

Exact order of the extension class and behavior for other parities remain unproved.

The class cannot be detected from existing ranks or complete rational characters and exposes a genuine failure of equivariant integral splitting.
